title: Release status feed (private store inputs/release-status.json)
description: What the weekly release check writes (proving-ground tools/release_check.py --status, decision 0028): per registered lab, whether its checks passed against the newest releases, as counts; the shared checks (SDK, model ids, CLIs, lab registry) summarised once. No output text, path or person, so nothing a check printed leaves the run. Kept as an input, never an event; the freshness register reads run_at.

lab.description: The scenario slug, as the schedule's lab field names it

unit.description: The unit the lab serves; null until the registry links it
